summary: Re-tested both iteration_2 fixes for Nellai Karupatti Coffee manager app. BOTH FIXES VERIFIED. Backend pytest (17/17 PASS) including new TestCascadeDelete that seeds a leave_entry + advance_entry and confirms both are removed on DELETE /api/employees/{id}. Frontend /advances at 1920x1080 now shows apply-bulk and clear buttons with a 20px gap (no overlap); bulk=250 + Apply to all fills all inputs with 250; Save advances persists amount to backend (verified via GET). Salary spot-check (12000 - 1200 - 200 = 10600) passes.
critical_code_review_comments: delete_employee cascade uses two separate delete_many calls — no transaction. Low risk because they're independent collections, but on partial failure (e.g. network blip between the two) orphans could still remain. Acceptable for this app scale.
AdvanceEntry top panel is now a clean 12-col 3+3+2+2+2 grid; responsive fall-back to md:grid-cols-2 looks correct. No further layout issues detected at 1920x1080.
test_credentials: admin@workforce.com / admin123 (seeded by backend on startup)
seed_data_creation: Test created 'TEST_Karthik', 'TEST_Cascade_User' and 'UI_Adv_<rand>' employees and deleted them after the run. No residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers auth, employees CRUD, leaves, advances (incl. zero-deletes), salary arithmetic, dashboard stats AND cascade delete (TestCascadeDelete). For frontend, the AdvanceEntry overlap assertion uses bounding-box gap >= 8px between advance-apply-bulk and advance-clear.

verification_evidence.salary_spot_check: salary=12000, leave_days=3, advance=200 => leave_deduction=1200, net_payable=10600 (asserted in TestCascadeDelete)
